summary: Leef Brands Inc. (issuer) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement dated April 14, 2026, where its wholly owned subsidiary (Merger Sub) will merge with and into Leef, leaving Leef as the surviving wholly owned subsidiary—effectively a reverse merger acquiring Standard Holdings, Inc. (SHI). Consideration: 12,592,960 Merger Shares to SHI senior preferred holders and $10,000 cash to common/seed preferred holders. SHI options/warrants cancel without consideration. Lock-up: 12 months with one-third releases every four months. The board retained certain SHI executives, issuing 1,095,040 Incentive Shares and 547,520 warrants. Watch for working capital adjustment post-close; risk-arb focuses on shareholder approval and customary closing conditions.
